title: Tell stale marks from fresh ones
breadcrumb: Tell stale marks from fresh ones

slides.title: Read the label
slides.html: The second line of a label gives the mark's age, Local when it did not come from a feed, and who sent it. A stale mark's label turns grey and reads Stale.

slides.title: Stale in the Inbox
slides.html: A stale report leaves Near you, 1 km, and its message stays greyed under Received. Tap Older reports (1) at the end of the Inbox to see it.

slides.title: Open older reports
slides.html: The older report opens in its place, greyed, with the day and time it was seen.

slides.title: Admins set the time
slides.html: Admins open OpenDefence Main from ATAK's ≡ menu and scroll to Server configuration (admins). They pick from 6 h to 7 d under Enemy marks go stale after, then publish the setup.
